product_metadata.title: Margaritaville DM1595-000-000 Key West Frozen Concoction Maker with Jumbo Jar and Travel Bag
features: Restaurant quality frozen drinks at home
Shaves ice and blends with your favorite ingredients for great frozen drinks
Automatic setting takes all the guesswork out of smoothly blended frozen drinks
54 ounce jumbo jar with double wall insulation lets you serve your guests faster and keeps the drinks colder, longer
Bonus Travel bag is a heavy duty canvas bag, padded to protect the frozen concoction maker with handles to carry it anywhere you want to go
description: Key West Frozen Concoction Maker, shaves ice and blends with your favorite ingredients for restaurant quality drinks. Includes extra large (54 ounce) double wall insulated jar and rugged canvas travel bag with padding and handles. The machine has an automatic setting that knows how much ice to shave and how long to blend to make great frozen drinks. Plus, if you want to customize the drinks a little further there are manual controls to shave more ice or blend a little longer. No one does frozen drinks like the Key West Frozen Concoction Maker.
